name: Heavy Large Rotor
description: Three standard number inputs control the rotor's swashplate, allowing you to affect the pitch, roll, and collective rotor angle. Power received from an engine affects the amount of up and down force that the rotor will generate.
shortDescription: A large heavy duty rotor with thrust vectoring.

logicNodes.label: Roll
logicNodes.description: Standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired roll amount.

logicNodes.label: Pitch
logicNodes.description: Standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired pitch amount.

logicNodes.label: Collective
logicNodes.description: Standard value between -1 and 1 representing the desired pitch amount.

logicNodes.label: RPS
logicNodes.description: Receives power generated by an engine.
